title: clinopodium libanoticum
intro: Clinopodium libanoticum, commonly known as Syrian savory, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is traditionally used in Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisine for its flavor and aroma. The health benefits of Clinopodium libanoticum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including borneol, camphor, and bornyl acetate, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include acting as a sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent.
